---
title: "Plant physiology: proposed topics"
---

These units organise the planned plant half. They are outlines rather than
complete lessons or a confirmed teaching order.

## Plant organisation

Connect cells, walls, tissues, meristems and genomes with growth and function.

## Resource acquisition and transport

Explain water balance, roots, xylem, transpiration, stomata, minerals and
membrane transport.

## Carbon and metabolism

Connect photosynthesis, environmental conditions, carbon allocation,
respiration and nutrient assimilation to growth.

## Regulation and development

Follow signals and hormones through germination, vegetative growth,
flowering, reproduction, senescence and cell death.

## Environment and applications

Explain stress, biotic interactions, natural products and growth–defence
relationships. Connect model systems, transformation, tissue culture and
gene expression to plant biotechnology and its ethical questions.

Experiments, literature discussion and scientific communication accompany
these topics. Actual protocols and experiment durations remain to be confirmed.
